text:
meera: Quick sync — I ran an "activation-harmonics" variant of SmoothQuant on model-x-13b (64k context) comparing AWQ / GPTQ / mixed-FP8. Posting numbers + short config snippets.

praveen: Nice. baseline = fp16? what harness/settings?

meera: Baseline = fp16 (no quant). SLO we care about: 120ms/token p50 at batch=1 with KV cache hot. Replay harness is the longctx replay (real-user trace).

tara: Which evals did you run for quality?

meera: Long-context summarization (64k targets), LLM-QA slices, and 1k-shot coherence checks. Highlights below (all runs on the same GPU family, same micro-batching). Table ->

```
MODEL | CONFIG | tokens/sec | p50 tok latency (ms) | ROUGE-L delta vs FP16 | KV-evictions/1M tok
model-x-13b | fp16 (baseline)            | 100 t/s | 95 ms  | 0.0  | 0
model-x-13b | AWQ (act-harmonics)       | 96  t/s | 102 ms | -0.9 | 2
model-x-13b | GPTQ (standard)           | 93  t/s | 110 ms | -1.6 | 8
model-x-13b | FP8 (mixed-quant)         | 108 t/s | 88 ms  | -2.4 | 1
```

meera: Notes: AWQ with our "activation-harmonics" preconditioning recovered most of the quality loss vs GPTQ while keeping KV-eviction low. FP8 gives the best perf but larger ROUGE hit on summarization (systematic under-generation on long refs).

oleg: Interesting — FP8 improves throughput/latency but harms RG-L. Did you use per-layer act scale calibration?

meera: For AWQ I used per-layer harmonic multipliers computed on 256-sample calibration set (prefixed segments). For FP8 we used global dynamic range clip + layerwise bias fold. Config snippet: 

```
quant_config = {
  "engine": "awq-act-harmonics",
  "calib_samples": 256,
  "per_layer_multiplier": true,
  "kv_prefetch": false  # baseline
}
```

praveen: How about safety/regression thresholds? any catastrophic tokens or hallucination spikes?

meera: Eval-bot ran regressions. Summary: AWQ-act-harmonics = 3 failures out of 120 tests >2% delta; GPTQ = 9 failures; FP8 = 18 failures. No catastrophic toxic-generation observed.

eval-bot: CI report: AWQ-act-harmonics: avg delta -0.9 ROUGE-L, 3/120 tests exceed 2% threshold -> flagged for review. Full logs: /internal/artifacts/1950012345/ (upload pending).

tara: Could we try KV prefetch + smaller KV chunk eviction policy? My hypothesis: GPTQ's numeric jitter causes extra small spikes in attention values triggering eviction heuristics. Prefetch might mask that.

meera: Good call. Next run plan: AWQ-act-harmonics + per-layer recalib (512 samples) + kv_prefetch=true + kv-evict-threshold bump. Will run as nightly job on dedicated pool.

oleg: Also try changing logits-preservation strategy (softmax temp clamp) — we saw this help on other longctx models.

praveen: If AWQ + 512 calibrations + kv_prefetch keeps ROUGE delta <1% and tokens/sec within 5% of baseline, that's a shipable quant profile for Dedicated. Add rollout policy: canary 5% then 20%.

meera: Agreed. I'll kick off the job tonight and post results. tagging @eng-runtime for potential kernel-level tweaks if evictions persist. :thumbsup:

praveen: :eyes: thanks meera

meera: Uploading artifact and short notebook with eval harness once job finishes.
